prompt: A pale blue-robed human wizard with frost-rimed hair stands in left profile on a snow-covered battlefield, one hand thrust forward exhaling a cone of pale cyan frost across the scene. On the right, a hulking brown-furred ogre raises a heavy iron club to swing, but its swinging arm is sheathed in thick blue ice, frozen mid-strike, its power sapped, the club drooping. Snow and frost-fog fill the air. The background is a grey winter sky over a frozen field with bare black trees.

Close-up side profile of a snarling green-scaled lizard warrior, its muscular sword-arm encased in a thick block of jagged blue ice, the muscles withering and shrinking inside the frost, its longsword slipping from frozen fingers. Pale cyan magical cold radiates over its arm. The lizard grimaces in pain and weakness. The background is a dim frost-covered stone arena dusted with snow.

A brutish bare-chested orc warrior on the right kneels and buckles, his huge raised club-arm completely encased in a heavy block of pale blue ice, the frozen arm sagging downward, useless and weak, frost crackling over his shoulder. A slender blue-robed wizards hand intrudes from the left edge of the frame, fingers splayed, streaming cyan cold magic onto the orc. The orc grimaces, defeated and drained. The background is a dim snowy battlefield under a pale grey sky.

A young human wizard in a deep sapphire-blue hooded robe stands centered facing the viewer, both hands raised and cupped together conjuring a swirling orb of pale cyan frost, breath misting in the cold, icicles forming on his sleeves. A creeping sheet of blue rime-frost spreads outward across the stone floor away from him. The only light is the cold blue glow of his frost magic. The background is a shadowed stone wizards tower interior with frosted-over windows.
